findings.summary: A fresh repository per Bookmark request bypasses the live Library repository's shared mutation queue.

evidence.originalBehavior: create, placement, rename and removal use instance-local mutationTail through serial().
evidence.candidateBehavior: private createBookmark constructs a new AnyHierarchyRepository for each invocation and calls its create().

findings.implication: Bookmark creation may overlap local parent/folder operations that ordinary creation serializes on the live repository. This is a source-proven queue regression; no actual native race is claimed.
findings.requestedCorrection: Pass the private typed creator adapter to the existing live repository's create operation through a minimal optional using parameter. Keep its original serial closure, parent/member/readback checks and default creator behavior. Validate the supplied creator workspace. Do not introduce a second manager or weaken validation.

otherReviewedFacts: Existing plan/repository/intent validators permit an empty Name, preserving the original URL-first input flow.
Adapter reconstructs the complete intent and compares fingerprint, binding mutation ID, workspace, type, hierarchy collection/parent/position, Name and exact source URL.
Properties writes use current member/lease authorization independently of body block count; actual bodyless Native mount remains unqualified.
Host binding and UI/package peer reviews do not qualify this separate queue boundary.
